verdict.rationale: Kong documents MCP traffic governance, security and observability, an MCP Traffic Gateway, MCP server autogeneration from REST APIs, and cataloging MCP servers. None of this shows Kong acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers and uses their tools. Proxying and governing MCP traffic for other agents is an adjacent gateway role, and generating or serving MCP servers is the server side, so neither earns credit for this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
